'''Marmoth''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and was a part of the [[Relgim Run/Legends|Relgim Run]]. It was one of the ports of call of the luxury liner [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].

==History==
Marmoth was explored sometime between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].

==Inhabitants==
BY [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Marmoth boasted a population of 1 million to 10 million [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]].
